author: INVXDR
quote: The story was bland, nothing nothing worth talking about, Jason is one of the most boring characters I have ever played, a womans power fantasy of a man moulded into the perfect cuck. Nothing more. We need real developers, this was not designed for the fans of the series not one bit, where is the freedom? Invisible walls, action blocks and virtue signalling should not be a core mechanic in a GTA game, there was more freedom in GTA2. The creators have taken us for fools knowing we'd pay for this trash in the hype but nah I'm out I want a refund. THIS IS NOT GTA!
